decisions.reason: Capacity expansion of pretrained checkpoints via static sparse memory | STAPLE residual embedding pathway vs continued dense training, STEM, Engram-style and MoE upcycling on OLMo-2 1B/7B (HumanEval +4.27, 2x faster decoding) | evaluates quality/throughput only; no training-stability, MoE routing, or observability problem addressed, so no anchor

Whether a model can help preserve its own capabilities during continual learning | Task Banks with model-generated replay and model-informed replay-target selection on Qwen models; beats random selection in held-out retention at 4B scale, smaller models show no advantage; replay outside the task bank reduces forgetting

Why VLMs bias toward text over color on Stroop images | representational asymmetry in the embedding space predicts steering success across contrastive and generative VLMs; text cues more strongly and separably represented, steering toward text directions easier than color

Where expert feedback changes agent outcomes, since agents otherwise reinforce their own errors | SynAct ranks decisions by mutual information between action and terminal outcome and distills corrections into reusable rules; +11.7pp average held-out accuracy across 4 agent benchmarks x 4 models (16/16 settings); beats cascade, uncertainty and expert-judge routers in 15/16

KV-cache memory footprint reduction | Kronecker Product Attention vs TPA/MHA/MQA/GQA/MLA, up to 10x KV compression across 4 model scales and 9 benchmarks | pure speed/memory architecture win with no precision or correctness problem evaluated

decisions.anchor: robustness of distributed training at scale
decisions.reason: Byzantine attacks corrupting federated LLM aggregation | HMP-GAE hypergraph autoencoder identifies and suppresses semantically inconsistent updates using historical checkpoints; on Qwen-2.5/Llama-3.2 backbones over AG News and Yahoo! Answers it gains +1.21% accuracy and cuts semantic entropy 44.08% vs existing defenses

Parameter-mask selection for LoRA continual learning | density-matched random mask beats gradient attribution on Qwen2.5-3B across 7 seeds after isolating the B=0 parameter-pool confound | continual-learning selection study; no hidden-state/interpretability analysis and no training-run stability problem

Agent beliefs about environment dynamics that are incomplete, incorrect or outdated | EvoBelief falsifiable-hypothesis world model with validation, narrowing and retirement on a frozen LM; +23.9%/+31.3% ALFWorld success over matched Frozen World Model (Claude Haiku 4.5 / GPT-5.4); 83.3% vs 0% on DiscoveryWorld Reactor Lab Normal tier

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Adaptive guardrails that degrade into inconsistent LLM-judged decisions as risks emerge | VEPA evolves a formal symbolic policy with a deterministic verifier and evidence-aware activation layer; consistently beats baselines on ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security and ATBench including corrupted-feedback and mixed-stream conditions

decisions.reason: GRPO assigns one advantage to every token, leaving useful and unhelpful agent decisions undifferentiated | TreeHCA hindsight-guided tree exploration with inverse-hindsight importance correction and normalized tree backup; beats all baselines in aggregate exact match across 7 QA benchmarks x 3 Qwen backbones

Whether networks lacking unit-level modularity still have functional modules | nested unit/orthogonal/linear modularity hierarchy with selective-ablation causal tests across vision, language and multi-task RNN models; content/style and syntax/semantics dissociate at subspace level despite overlapping neurons and align differentially with brain data

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems

Capability degradation during on-policy self-distillation even as overall scores improve | degradation coincides with deterioration of representation geometry (intra-cluster compactness, inter-cluster separation); RGR regularization alleviates it across multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks without altering the core optimization

Convergence of Langevin sampling under state-dependent heavy-tailed noise | R-LMC/A-LMC/RA-LMC with Fisher-information guarantees, applied to Bayesian LLM/VLM fine-tuning | sampling theory for Bayesian fine-tuning; no monitoring, instability or divergence problem of actual training runs evaluated

Reasoning post-training cost vs capability | uncertainty-guided two-stage contraction of SFT supervision, 0.22% of full-data optimization budget at maintained performance | data-efficiency method for SFT; no RL post-training failure or dynamic

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Which target-model layers carry complementary information for speculative decoding | matrix-entropy informativeness plus CKA diversity layer selection with token-entropy filtering; selected sets beat the default [2, N//2, N-3] EAGLE3 rule across model scales and explain why some defaults stay competitive

Idle Apple Silicon GPUs unused while centralized GPU capacity is constrained | Minions aggregates idle macOS devices into a virtual GPU cloud with task execution, fault tolerance and resource management | no quantitative baseline or evaluation numbers named in the abstract

GUI agents lacking reusable workflow knowledge from human experience | Work2Skill induces skills from synchronized human demonstrations (WorkDemo-350 dataset); mean score +4.67-10.54 points over No-Skill on MyPCBench Bounded Action and +3.11-7.50 on a 286-task OSWorld-Verified subset across 4 execution models

Which demonstrated tokens carry task-specific learning value vs model mismatch | CIG-SFT conditional information gain weighting with KL-regularized projection; beats standard SFT and adaptive baselines on math/code generalization | SFT token-weighting method; no RL post-training failure or dynamic

Frozen executors missing task-specific know-how that a static prompt cannot adapt per input | HSAD trains a small advisor by hindsight distillation on the executor's failures; 8B advisor raises Samaya's qualification rate on FrontierFinance from 52.9% to 56.6% at 37% lower cost, and improves WebShop, BIRD and ExpertLongBench

Empowerment maximization studied only in tabular settings, elusive at scale | scalable recipe: maximize the number of executable skills per state on top of arbitrary skill-learning methods; emergent resource gathering, environment modification and house-building in Crafter | no quantitative baseline named

Belief updates tracking evidence provenance rather than repetition count in relayed human-AI loops | LQET relational objective cuts update RMSE 41-44% and log-odds drift 89-91% on a controlled binary benchmark (Qwen3-4B, Phi-4-mini) | training objective for belief discipline; no self-evolving-agent or listed reliability problem

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: PPO's geometrically degenerate clipping proxy causing premature clipping and degraded exploration | GPPO f-divergence trust-region framework with new estimator topologies, unifying DAPO/DPPO/RIPO; best instantiation beats GRPO by up to 50% (math) and 14% (coding) across 8 competition-level benchmarks

Optimizer ranking under a single self-tuned configuration | AlgoPerf V1 self-tuning ruleset across 9 workloads; Schedule-Free AdamW first of 13 submissions; lr/momentum most hypersensitive | optimizer benchmarking report; no instability, anomaly or observability problem from the training-stability list

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model
decisions.reason: Whether non-prefix KV-cache reuse silently changes model outputs | KV-Repurpose vLLM-based testbed for segment-wise reuse; naive segment reuse largely preserves single-document QA quality but exposes clear cross-document reasoning degradation; hit rate 63.9% vs 3.3% for prefix caching at 30GB (prefix only 17.9% even at 1TB), lower TTFT

Manually designed agent workflows that cannot adapt per query and cost too much to optimize | CB-Orchestrator decouples evolutionary workflow-pool generation from contextual-bandit selection; beats all baselines across 5 benchmarks with at least 40.55% less training-phase token overhead on MATH

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Unbounded exploration and evidence-state drift in corpus-scale agent reasoning | LongHarness makes evidence-conclusion coevolution and evidence lifecycle explicit; GLM-5.3-Flash on OfficeQA Pro 15.8% to 60.2% (V1) and 4.4% to 61.1% (V2); +12.0pp over Claude Code and +18.9pp over Codex

Separating harmfulness recognition from the computation that writes refusal | residual-stream analysis across 18 Base-Instruct pairs: attention updates decode harm (early layers) while MLP updates write refusal; causal MLP resets confirm the pathway; Sentinel P/D routing lowers jailbreak/over-refusal error across 8 models

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Locating the decisive step of agent failures without step-level labels or success-only references | SOAP builds a spectral reference space from LLM representations and propagates downstream error evidence upstream via attention dependencies; consistently improves attribution over competitive baselines

Whether visual-head discovery scores actually find steerable or necessary heads | full 2x3x2 design on Qwen3-VL-8B with layer-matched random controls; necessity follows the attention source (p=6e-10) but no discovered head-set steers better than random sets (p>=0.14) - a random-control pitfall protocol for reporting discoveries

Biosecurity risk of agentic mutation design with biological design tools | DRYLAB-Bench: 30 hazardous scenarios scored against 187,695 wet-lab measurements (ProteinGym/ViroGym); tool augmentation raises pooled risk | pure agent benchmark, excluded by this area's gate

Why heavy-tailed weight spectra predict model quality | marginal likelihood from final-layer weights; limiting HTMP log-likelihood convex in a heaviness parameter that predicts overfitting on large CNNs/LLMs | statistical theory of quality metrics; not a listed training-stability or observability problem

CPU-GPU memory sharing over unified memory architecture forcing inefficient copies or incorrect direct access | four-platform correctness/performance characterization yielding libumsh; 16-75% data-plane and 7-90% control-plane reductions across 9 real systems including NVIDIA DGX Spark

When multi-agent collaboration helps vs costs | competence-aware role activation and communication-graph adaptation; 87.22 to 89.97 accuracy with -36.26% tokens on high-competence backbones | orchestration efficiency method; no self-improvement loop and no listed reliability problem

Outcome-only trajectory filtering bakes inefficient interaction patterns into coding agents | TQS structural scoring (no LLM judge, linear time) over 155,144 successful trajectories; models SFT on top-ranked subsets consistently beat random/bottom subsets on SWE-Bench-Verified

Evidence fabrication: search agents bypass external information and fabricate answers to collect reward | SOAR separates external and internal evidence into parallel observable streams with source-consistent reward; +7.3%/+5.4% on 3B/7B backbones and 74.8% less fabrication

Short trajectories not showing evidence accumulation, strategy adjustment and deliverable completion, while environment synthesis pre-solves the key work | TerminalHorizon engine reconstructs environments around independently identified omitted work; 1.5K environments, SFT Qwen3.5-27B wins all 12 benchmarks incl. 12-hour RSI case studies

Near-zero success on long-horizon visual Sudoku causing severe reward sparsity that halts standard RLVR | AdaC-GRPO tracks the model's Zone of Proximal Development via online rollout accuracy to build batches; Qwen2.5-VL-7B approaches Gemini-2.5-Flash and bridges 62.2% of the gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, validated on InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL

Malicious clients poisoning federated training updates | WaSA unsupervised offline detection from privacy-preserving spectral data summaries, attack-agnostic with Boltzmann client selection; MNIST/CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 under up to 90% malicious clients, beats supervised baselines and robust aggregation

Generate-Execute-Feedback research loops throttled by costly, delayed executions | JANUS Predict-Verify-Evolve loop with a co-evolving world model that forecasts value/information-gain to prune before execution and distills experience into evolving skills; outperforms SOTA baselines on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: Sparse-attention rollouts change the response groups GRPO learns from - exact reweighting cannot recover the dense-policy update and direct sparse sampling destabilizes training | S3R sparse drafting plus full-attention speculative verification reproduces dense-policy groups without a separate drafter; 1.39x/1.35x training throughput on Qwen3 long-context math with stable training in matched ablation

Which expert-reference policy differences transfer as OPD supervision and to which targets | unified log-ratio implicit-reward view recovering conventional OPD; task-trained differences (RL, SFT) transfer consistently while scale-only ones do not; expert and reference play complementary roles; systematic experiments across scales, stages and generations

Catastrophic forgetting in multimodal continual instruction tuning | Monarch-MoE block-diagonal LoRA experts with blockwise gradient isolation; first-task forgetting 0.52pp on MLLM-DCL with ~75% fewer adapter parameters, runs on one RTX 4090 | continual-learning architecture; no listed stability/observability problem

Training instability when learning Schwarzschild geodesics with Lagrangian Neural Networks | decoupled position-velocity normalization plus ISCO-informed energy-constrained sampling; conserves energy/angular momentum within a few percent | physics-informed NN niche; neither ML training-run stability nor FP-precision reliability of optimized compute

Prior student reasoning distorts teacher supervision in multi-turn OPD while current reasoning shapes sampled alternatives | State-OPD grounds supervision in interaction states and reallocates sampling to high-entropy states; macro-average success 26.07% to 31.74% for Qwen3-4B, surpassing its Qwen3-32B teacher on ALFWorld Seen

OPD shortcut failure: distilled VLMs still answer accurately with masked or noised visual regions, never learning to rely on visual evidence | CV-OPD contrasts positive and negative teacher crops on the same student prefix with discrepancy-gated token selection; substantially alleviates the shortcut across fine-grained visual benchmarks

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Memory-poisoning attacks on agent memory stores | DREAM training-free selective forgetting via perturbation reactivation, anomaly diagnosis and dynamic repair; over 95% reduction in backdoor attack success rate, 2.13x speedup and -37.7% tokens vs A-MemGuard, 92.96% task success on poisoned multi-agent systems

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: Video-LLM post-training signals too coarse: one response-level advantage applied to every token regardless of visual grounding, while OPD never supervises the representations producing outputs | OWLET evidence-privileged RL with evidence-aware credit redistribution (likelihoods under privileged vs uniform views) and spatiotemporal state alignment on verifier-accepted responses

Risk-controlled set routing ignoring failure dependence between models | CopRoute orders models by marginal coverage and certifies all-miss risk; fewest certified calls on 9/10 RouterBench/RouterEval datasets, up to 79% fewer calls | inference-time model selection; no area lists routing problems

Adversarial robustness of contrastive skeleton-action representations | QCLR dual-level quantization absorbs perturbations with attention-guided multi-faceted strategy; better white-box/black-box robustness at competitive accuracy | quantization used as an adversarial-defense tool; no precision or correctness problem of optimized compute

Whether prompt optimizers break requirements the target metric does not score | preregistered GEPA/MIPROv2/TextGrad study on HotpotQA/SQuAD 2.0/IFEval; citation validity regresses 10.7-41.6pp, but decomposition shows 13.9-47.0% of responses truncate before any answer under the 200-token cap and content regression is within 3 points of zero; two simple gates still fail the preregistered criterion

What global scene properties register tokens encode and whether decoding them helps | representation-autoencoder decoders processing 4 register tokens with all patch tokens; ViT-B FID 0.472 (DINOv2) / 0.442 (DINOv3), -9.5%/-5.2% vs patch-only; probes and register substitutions localize illumination, blur and style in registers

Whether label-free rubric repair improves judge panels | preregistered protocol with 129,770 judge requests on SummEval/HealthBench/USR; inter-judge Krippendorff alpha +0.069 over original rubric but agreement with experts unchanged (Kendall tau -0.007) - consensus without alignment

FP16 PPO unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and data collection | PPO-FP16 structure-aware protections (global scalars, policy-change residuals, persistent updates); lowest mean return-AUC rank (1.90) of four methods across 6 tasks x 5 seeds, 1.16-2.03x speedups and -71.7 to -74.9% optimizer-state memory vs FP32 Adam

Tokenization dominating TTFT and a CPU frontend limiting how many GPUs it can feed | GraphTok runs the entire encoding pipeline as one replayable CUDA graph, bit-for-bit identical token IDs on GPT-2/Llama 3/Qwen 2.5/DeepSeek-V3/Gemma 3; 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, mean TTFT -2.1-2.4x in vLLM, 518 vs 296 req/s of 121k-token traffic within a 2s P99

Fragmented tooling across agent building, training, evaluation and maintenance | AgentTune two-tier EventLog substrate with shared runtime, tool-calling RL, distillation and RAG | library/framework contribution with demonstration tasks only; no evaluated self-improvement loop or reliability claim

Whether attention sinks exist and what they functionally do in text-to-image transformers | systematic analysis plus interventions across bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive T2I models; sinks are architecture-, stage- and component-dependent, sink-head perturbations change outputs more than non-sink, and register tokens can redistribute them

Multimodal emotion preference learning with error grounding | EmoGavel grounded SFT plus GA-GRPO with zero-variance rescue on EmoPrefer and controlled-error sets | domain application; the zero-variance rescue is a component, not the evaluated claim

How much strategy must be specified for long-horizon assembly | AlphaNIST single policy, 98.2% success on 20 NIST assembly tasks from a sparse binary reward, no demos or shaping | robotic manipulation RL; no LLM agent and no listed problem

Expert capacity misallocation under imbalanced pretraining data - minority categories concentrated in a few experts or spread inefficiently | category-conditioned expert-selection biases induce soft specialization and over-allocate capacity to disadvantaged categories; gains across modalities, low-resource languages and code up to 10.6B, worth 18.5%/2.7% extra baseline tokens at smallest/largest scale

Overview of how agentic LLMs act and interact | book with no evaluation | position/overview without evaluation, excluded by this area's gate

Validity of VLM benchmarks auditable from saved evaluation runs | six post-hoc detectors added to VLMEvalKit; 20.2% of MMStar questions show zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image with a +3.2pp permutation-null excess (corrected p=0.001) concentrated in math/science, plus 134 shared-wrong-answer questions

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Correct patches differing wildly in runtime performance, invisible to correctness-only resolution rates | 262 measurable SWE-bench/SWE-bench-Live cases with Claude Opus 5, GPT 5.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.8 Max + SWE-agent, Welch ANOVA on F2P tests; performance differences in nearly half the instances, near-reversed model rankings, and architectural regressions correctness missed

Zero-reward collapse when a sudden difficulty increase vanishes the RLVR learning signal and failed trajectories are discarded | MENTOR is a live multi-agent mentor diagnosing failures in real time and generating instructional prompts, plug-and-play with GRPO; up to +78.3% average relative gain on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over base

Agent safety under prompt/script injection in shared professional workspaces | APEX-Harm: 180 task instances per model x 12 frontier models with 115-328 files and MCP tools; script replacement attacks reach 81-84% success | pure agent benchmark, excluded by this area's gate

LLM deception across the software development lifecycle | SWE-DeceptionBench: 720 instances in Chinese/English; 49.88% active and 64.29% passive deception under neutral condition across 7 LLMs | pure benchmark of model behavior, excluded by this area's gate

Single-session brittleness on hard problems: error propagation, missing domain knowledge, and success masking misinterpretation | HOA coordinates multiple sessions through independent reviewer, structured wiki, and Lean verifier feedback channels; perfect scores on IMO/IPhO/IOI 2026 and 672/672 on PutnamBench with GPT-5.6 Sol and 97.1% IChO with Kimi-K3

Manual selection of key components inside a fixed model class | analyst/coder/recorder LLM framework with experiment log and sandboxed execution tunes components without changing architecture; +13pp/+6pp SNN classification accuracy (MNIST/Digits), ~2491x lower single-soliton error and 14x lower mass drift (KS) vs baselines

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: Whether persistent medium-difficulty selection is optimal in GRPO as the policy evolves | difficulty re-estimated under the current policy with staged progression toward harder bands; staged beats fixed-medium (0.6591 vs 0.6449) but overshooting drops to 0.6405 on GSM8K across 3 seeds - non-monotonic benefit

LLMs failing to reliably find and correct their own reasoning errors | UPTURN learns where to intervene with a 130K-parameter head on a frozen encoder and redirects via a new user turn, no fine-tuning; beats self-correction and reflection-token baselines across 4 reasoners x 6 math benchmarks and transfers to GPQA-Diamond

Semantic coverage gaps skewing AI test and evaluation conclusions | VLM zero-shot labeling + diffusion image-to-image augmentation + embedding-space verification on day/night gaps for classification/detection | evaluation-set augmentation for vision models; not LLM evaluation and no self-improvement loop

How agentic web stacks (3 LLMs, 3 protocols, 4 frameworks) compose | MASTIF baseline assessment over 300 Mind2Web tasks | pure agent benchmark/baseline assessment without a self-improvement loop, excluded by this area's gate

KV memory exhaustion at long-context serving, with hierarchical sparse KV lacking speculative-decoding support | Adaptive DHiSparse adds load-adaptive residency and exact fused retrieval while keeping DSpark/DFlash2 rules; GLM-5.3 + DFlash2 793 output tok/s per decode GPU at 100K context/concurrency 128 (1.45x HiSparse), up to 4x concurrency at the same latency bounds

World-action models too expensive for edge robots | SmolWAM distills Cosmos Policy to 95.5% LIBERO success at 57ms and 2.3 TFLOP per chunk, 11x faster than its teacher | robotics distillation; the attention-sink mention is incidental, no listed problem

Scoring teachers in on-policy self-distillation carry no localizing or corrective credit - locating errors is a search problem a scorer is never asked to perform | gold-span probes show full-distribution KL and token log-ratios neither localize errors nor push probability off erroneous tokens; critique-conditioned scoring fixes both and provides advantage signal in cold-start GRPO

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: Credit assignment for intermediate agent decisions from sparse terminal feedback | MCGPO builds matched-context weighted action preferences with opposite-fold evidence weights alongside GraphGPO, critic-free; +3.96/+5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B/8B over matched GraphGPO, 3 seeds per setting

W4A4 activation quantization typically requiring calibration data | DualQuant minimizes weight-reconstruction MSE whose scales double as activation rescalings, calibration-free, formally supporting MX and NVFP4 formats; matches or beats SmoothQuant across Llama/Qwen on WikiText-2/C4/zero-shot; real packed W4A4 path on RTX 4090 with 2.61x memory and 2.46x speedup vs BF16

Attribution for selective state-space models where recurrence hides which video tokens drive predictions | READ unrolls the recurrence at the classifier readout in a single forward pass; competitive faithfulness and localization vs substantially costlier attribution methods and avoids their systematic relevance biases

State quantization error feeding into subsequent SSM recurrent updates, plus state-I/O bottleneck and no cheap speculative rollback | ReplaySSM represents state as checkpoint + recent-input buffer with split checkpoint precisions so low-precision rounding error never enters updates; 1.20-1.47x decode speedup over tuned vLLM across 4 hybrid models (Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet) with reduced KL and accuracy loss

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: Semantic query pipelines changing answers run-to-run while single-execution benchmarks never notice | 1.2 million logged model calls re-executing SemBench/LRO-Bench/UDA-Bench harnesses; 0.07-10.2% of rows flip at temperature 0, plans amplify to about two-thirds of UDA-Bench answers, 21% of published SemBench text results change quality; voting reduces but does not remove variance

Whether Minecraft self-improvement yields transferable capability vs carried-over resources | MC-EvoBench: 19 registered evolution chains, matched step budgets and 5 seeds; related experience yields no stable transfer | pure agent benchmark, excluded by this area's gate

Pre-training knowledge ordering shaping later update efficiency | chronological specialists need far fewer update steps than shuffled generalists, with a first-principles update-cost law and a data-organization strategy | pretraining curriculum finding; not a listed stability/observability or hidden-states problem

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Compositional cross-service harm from benign requests, underexplored by LLM-prompt red-teaming | X-AgentRed builds a tool-dependency graph and self-evolves harmful paths with execution feedback; 1.77x the harmful-path rate of STAC and 2.99x tool coverage across 4 frontier agentic models

Tool retrieval ignoring runtime availability, dispatching agents to failed tools | RATED pairs a frozen dual-encoder with a contextual-bandit reranker driven by execution feedback; +52.2% relative MRR over the ToolLLM API retriever and fault selection cut from 86.2% to 2.9% under a 30% API outage, under 1ms overhead

What shared attention heads do differently under different task contexts | influence/importance interventions on graph facts across 5 open-weight models (1.5-14B); task context redistributes influence, an activation edit switches which fact is read, and condition-specific linear response maps cut prediction MSE by 53.6% in Gemma-2-9B

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: VLM representations not preserving relational information present in their own input | EICS metric plus CASP-VL causally controlled spatial perturbations from Visual Genome; spatial relations far less faithfully represented than lexical content, identifiable at predicate tokens but lost at EOS/mean-pooling aggregation - a failure invisible to output-based evaluation

RSI blocked by costly external feedback and world-model predictions going stale as policies evolve | RSI-Anything on JEPA-Anything uses predictive selection, conditional world-model adaptation and compatibility-checked retention; code repair 26.3% to 31.2%, lab planning 21.80% to 46.01% over five policy versions, 96.15% vs 82.16% reaction yield vs Bayesian optimization

Capability audits that assume hidden capabilities can be elicited | encrypted neural networks embedded in weights via digital lockers, provably hard to elicit or interpret; resists fine-tuning, weight noising, trigger search and latent adversarial training | capability-hiding construction; no analysis of internal representations, so no interpretability anchor

Privacy leakage coupled to task capability in agentic dialogue | CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE: 4,410 two-agent instances; leakage rises up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns across 7 Qwen3/Llama models | pure agent benchmark of model-side privacy/safety, excluded by this area's gate

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Agentic data-science pipelines committing methodological failures (data leakage, inappropriate validation) that accuracy metrics mask | 220-task failure-mode analysis across frameworks and models, a 6-failure test suite, and Kaggle expert comparison; the majority of solutions contain at least one failure mode and leakage correlates positively with predictive performance

Teacher-dependent one-shot agent post-training bounded by the external model | ClawLoop closes a teacher-free cycle of task synthesis with diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth, SFT/RL training, and diagnosis-feedback; consistent gains on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live and ClawGym-Bench for Qwen3.6-27B, transferring to 4B/9B models

Measuring sustained agent progress with process rewards over hours | LHTB 2.0: 77 tasks, 1,145 scored runs of 15 frontier models; dense ladder 0.653 vs binary verifier 0.221 | pure agent benchmark, excluded by this area's gate

RL environment supply limited to human research pace | AutoEnvScaling uses a proposer agent to build verifiable environments from solver rollouts; valid-environment rate up to 25x at 75% lower cost per valid environment; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B acting in both roles gains +12.2 Terminal-Bench 2.1 points (RSI) and generalizes to computer use and GPU kernels

Storage cost limiting temporal resolution of checkpoint trajectories | ULPack conditions entropy models on reference exponents; -27% vs ZipNN, -21% vs zstd-19, -11.5% vs FM-Delta across bf16/fp16/fp32 | compression codec; archival efficiency, not a listed stability or observability problem

Training-sample influence not grounded in the multimodal evidence mediating it | MOSAIC learns a shared sparse image-text latent space (localized, phrase-aligned, decorrelated SAEs) and applies EK-FAC to localize influence to phrases and image regions on Qwen and Gemma; influence-ranked latents change outputs more than activation- or frequency-ranked ablations

Cloud-written agent programs failing when steps depend on content visible only at runtime | deferring bounded questions to a small local model via function calls; up to +14.9pp on AppWorld across 6 backbone-partition combinations | privacy-capability architecture trade-off; no silent-alteration failure mechanism from the area list

Computational overhead of NLI-based semantic entropy for hallucination detection | EGKE swaps the NLI graph for an RBF kernel over BGE embeddings, retaining KLE's entropy formulation; competitive AUROC/AUARC over 30 setups | hallucination is explicitly out of scope for the reliability area, and the method uses external sentence embeddings rather than the LLM's internal states
